title: Dyonic Kerr-Sen Black Hole's Resonant Scattering: Absorption and Superradiance
summary: We analytically investigate scalar superradiant scattering in the rotating dyonic Kerr-Sen black hole of Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton-Axion theory. Starting from the separable Klein-Gordon equation for a massive neutral scalar field, we work in the low-frequency and slow-rotation regime and employ the analytical asymptotic matching (AAM) method to compute the reflection coefficient and the associated superradiant amplification factor.
